additional_info.subject: ID0433600-DC/Si-D/CZ- [Y2 / S4 313659082001] Charger remains stuck at 30% CRM:02684000353
additional_info.body:
Hi Jose,
Unfortunately, I was not able to factory reset the router remotely as it went offline. Definitely looks like there is something wrong with the router.
My suggestion is to go on-site with the error active and check what is the condition of the router.
If the router is showing the WebUI and has no problem, this might indicate a problem with the Ethernet cable or the switch.
Here my recommendation is to use a brand new Ethernet cable or a different switch port.
Example, swap Router 1 ethernet with Router 2 and see if the problem is swapped.
If the Router 2 is now working and Router 1 is not working, then we have a faulty Ethernet cable/port
If the problem persists then it shows a problem with the router.
If the router is completely offline:
Please check if the 24V supply cable is inserted properly.
If the problem persisten then it's most likely a router issue.
If a factory reset is required:
If it's a RUT241, it will have a password on the back of the router and you will need to change it via WebUI to the one in SCB and reboot:
lrSmxJZh9Vn3xsTxhZGo
If it's a RUT240, you only need to factory reset it and reboot the charger. Since it's in a recent version, the charger is able to configure the router automatically during boot -> it might take longer to boot up.
If the factory reset doesn't work, then please replace the Router.
Please let me know if you understood everything and I can send you the ticket.
I will stay connected to the charger and see if I get the router online again to factory reset it remotely.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
